claims.text: The source defines LCM-LoRA: LoRA-parameterised consistency acceleration (trainable 67.5M for SD-V1.5 0.98B, 105M for 1.3B, 197M for SDXL 3.5B); acceleration vector plus style vector combinable without training (e.g. 0.8/1.0); neural probability-flow-ODE plug-in with 4-step guidance at 512/1024.
Reported scope: qualitative 4-step 512-V1.5/1024-SDXL/1B generations vs DPM-Solver++ at higher NFE; no FID/CLIP table in this report (defers to LCM).

limitations.text: Report-only, no new benchmark; combination weights heuristic; per-model generality needs validation.
